crossRefs.note: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself…
The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him…
But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

translations.web: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,
translations.bsb: If, however, the scaly outbreak spreads further on the skin after his cleansing,
translations.kjv: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
translations.asv: But if the scall spread abroad in the skin after his cleansing,
